title: picking manager seed widget
explanation:
### Description

Demonstrate vtkPickingManager with a cube of seed widgets.

**dataset → renderer → infrastructure → scene → interaction → output**

- [vtkInteractorStyleTrackballCamera](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkInteractorStyleTrackballCamera.html) — interactor style trackball camera.
- [vtkSeedRepresentation](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkSeedRepresentation.html) — seed representation.
- [vtkSeedWidget](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkSeedWidget.html) — seed widget.
- [vtkSphereHandleRepresentation](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkSphereHandleRepresentation.html) — sphere handle representation.
- [vtkRenderWindow](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindow.html) — displays the rendered scene in a window on screen.
- [vtkRenderWindowInteractor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindowInteractor.html) — captures mouse and keyboard events.
- [vtkRenderer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderer.html) — assembles the scene and configures the camera.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
